I have farmed this place a long time, so I do not start from empty. I start from what worked last year and then I adjust a little. On 18 mu, I cannot play too many risky games, but I am not too small either, so I will spend where I think yield is protected first. We have well water, so I count on irrigation when the sky does not help. Around Quzhou, if cotton is short of fertilizer or water, the bolls stay small and I lose money fast, so I will keep more land in cotton. Wheat and maize I will keep too, but on smaller area. With my schooling, I do look at cost and the way the crop grows, not only habit. Nitrogen I will not cut too hard, because if yield falls, that loss is bigger than wasting a bit of fertilizer. Phosphorus I will put at sowing so roots come strong, and potassium I will not skip on cotton because cotton needs sturdier plants and better boll setting. For seed, I will use improved or hybrid seed where I have seen good stands on nearby fields. Tillage I will keep simple and reliable: plough for cotton ground, rotary for wheat and maize ground. For cotton I will water about 4 times if the season is normal, spray about 5 times because insects are never light. Wheat I will water 3 times and spray 2 times. Maize I will water 2 times and spray 2 times. That is how I will manage it this year.
